manual: VEX V5 Robotics Competition Override - Game Manual v2.0
note: Need to be filled in by you for each version of the game manual.

rules.title: Starting a Match
rules.description: less then 18”, not contacting objects, tocuhing the wall, in its own quadrant, and stationary

rules.title: Horizontal expansion is limited
rules.description: must fit within a 24” x 24” square horizontal footprint

rules.title: Vertical expansion is limited.
rules.description: no part of the Robot may exceed an overall height of 50”

rules.title: Keep Scoring Objects in the Field
rules.description: minor but if it keeps happening it escalates

rules.title: Each Robot gets one Pin as a Preload
Possession is limited to a maximum of one Pin and one Cup
rules.description: Ponsidered Possessed by a Robot if the Scoring Object is fully supported by the Robot, or if the Robot’s movement in all directions would result in maintained control of the Scoring Object

rules.title: Don’t cross the Autonomous Line and don’t interfere with your opponents’ actions
rules.description: contact with either a robot or scoring object on the opponents side gives winpoint

rules.shortTitle: Autonomous Line at your own risk
rules.title: Engage with the Midfield and/or Autonomous Line during the Autonomous Period at your own risk
Alliance Goals are protected.
rules.description: The alliance may knock over their own goals, Making contact with the Goal or with Scoring Objects stacked on the Goal, Adding or removing Placed Scoring Objects, Strategically covering the Goal, Pushing an opposing Robot into Scoring Objects stacked in their own Alliance-colored Goal, knocking some or all of them out of the Goal

rules.title: Placed Scoring Objects may not be removed from neutral Goals
rules.description: Worth 10 points for the first 3 pins, worth 50 points with an interaction removing 4+

rules.title: Drive Team Members may introduce Match Loads to the Field through Loaders
rules.description: Only one at a time (pin and cup), may have momentary contact with human and load and robot and load, after let go can not be grabed again

rules.title: Some rules change during the Endgame period
rules.description: Last 10 seconds no scoreing on the mid goal, Holding is allowed

rules.title: Load Zones are protected during the Driver Controlled Period of the Match
rules.description: May not enter, may not stop or interact with the opponents

rules.title: Only Drive Team Members, and only in the Alliance Station
rules.description: Only up to 3 drive team members, No communication devices

rules.title: A Teams Robot should attend every Match
rules.description: No robot will mean a NO SHOW

rules.title: Robots on the Field must be ready to play
rules.description: battery charged, sized within the starting size constraint, includes only the correct Alliance-color license plates, etc

rules.title: Hands out of the Field
rules.description: (SG11 for match loading disrupts this rule)

rules.title: Match replays are allowed, but rare
rules.description: Match affecting feild issues

rules.title: Disqualifications
Time-outs
rules.description: Used in elimination

rules.title: Keep your Robots together
rules.description: Robots may not intentionally detach parts during the Match or leave mechanisms on the Field.

rules.title: Don’t hook your Robot to the Field, and don’t get Entangled
The red Alliance may choose to place last
Controllers must stay connected to the Field
Autonomous means no humans
All rules still apply in the Autonomous Period
rules.description: Breaking a rules results in a loss of the auton

rules.title: Don’t destroy other Robots. But, be prepared to encounter defense
Offensive Robots get the “benefit of the doubt“
You can’t force an opponent into a penalty
rules.description: SG9 goes to a minor when forcing an opponent into a major

rules.title: No Holding for more than a 3-count
rules.description: Holding = trappping, lifting, pinning

rules.title: Use Scoring Objects to play the game
rules.description: don't use them as a glove

rules.title: Participants must follow the Code of Conduct
Participants must follow the Student Centered Policy
Use common sense
Students must meet the Student Eligibility Policy requirements
There is a difference between accidentally and willfully violating a Robot rule
rules.description: A Team that circumvents a Robot rule for a competitive advantage should receive an immediate Disqualification for the current Match

rules.title: Be safe out there
rules.description: If at any time the Robot operation or Team actions are deemed unsafe or have damaged a Field Element, Scoring Object, or the Field, the offending Team may receive a Disablement and/or Disqualification at the discretion of the Head Referee. The Robot will require re-inspection as described in rule <R2> before it may take the Field again.

rules.title: Students must be accompanied by an Adult
rules.description: Every Student at a VEX Robotics Competition event must be supervised by a responsible Adult. The Adult must obey all rules and be careful to not violate Student-centered policies, but must be present for the full duration of the event in the case of an emergency. Violations of this rule may result in removal from the event and additional penalties

rules.title: Each Student Team member must have a completed participant release form on file for the event and season.
Stay inside the Field
Wear safety glasses
